title: Notice regarding Special Court on 30.11.2026.
text:

Date: - 27/11/2026

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 27/11/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 30.11.2026 ;
1. Hon’ble Ms. Justice Gita Gopi and Hon’ble Mr. Justice L. S.
Pirzada would sit in Special Division Bench and take up the
notified matters at 02:30 PM.
2. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble
Ms. Justice Gita Gopi would sit Single and take up the
matters as per Roster.
3. After completion of matters at Sr. No.1 above, Hon’ble
Mr. Justice L. S. Pirzada would sit Single and take up the
matters as per Roster.
By Order
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
